area_note: Metro Manila, including Bonifacio Global City (BGC) in Taguig, Makati and Quezon City
intro: Most Metro Manila group runs start in the business districts: the Ayala Triangle and Rockwell in Makati, the High Street and 26th Street loops in BGC (which has wide sidewalks), and UP Diliman in Quezon City. Weekday sessions usually go out between 5am and 6:30am, or after work from about 6pm, and the long runs are on weekend mornings. The scene is mostly free, show-up-and-run clubs that post their schedules on Instagram or Facebook, alongside store clubs, paid coaching teams and two long-running hash kennels.

clubs.name: Just Show Up Club
clubs.who: All paces; no tryouts, no pace requirements
clubs.description: A Makati-based community club, set up in 2023 and formerly known as Rockwell Run Club, that runs several times a week across Makati and BGC. Its website schedule is the club's own source of truth for runs that are on, moved or cancelled.
clubs.active_evidence: Live weekly schedule on the club website, checked Sep 2026 (site © 2026, SS26 apparel line)

clubs.name: RunBGC by AthLife

meets.where: AthLife studio, Level 19, A.T. Yuchengco Centre, 5th Ave cor 25th St, BGC

clubs.cost: Free (booking via the AthLife app required)
clubs.who: Open to all; beginner-friendly, easy conversational pace
clubs.description: The run club of the AthLife Performance gym in BGC, with weekly sessions designed by the gym's coaches. Its 2026 restart was an easy 5km loop through BGC.
clubs.active_evidence: Club post announcing the weekly run's return on 10 Jan 2026

clubs.name: Makati Runners Club

meets.when: Saturdays 7:00am (10K Makati to BGC and back, then breakfast at Salcedo Market)
meets.where: Makati (start point shown to Meetup members)

meets.when: Sundays 6:30am (10K around Ayala Avenue, then breakfast at Legazpi Market)
meets.where: Makati (start point shown to Meetup members)

clubs.description: A Meetup group of about 1,370 members with two weekend 10km runs, each finishing at one of Makati's weekend markets. It is a private group, so meeting points are shown only after joining.
clubs.active_evidence: Meetup events listed for 26 and 27 Sep, 3 and 4 Oct, and 10 Oct 2026

clubs.name: Founders Running Club Manila

meets.where: Single Origin, Opus Mall, Bridgetowne, Quezon City

clubs.who: Founders, investors, tech and creative people; any pace, with pacers; friends, family and pets welcome
clubs.description: The Manila chapter of a networking run club that started in San Francisco in 2022. It holds an easy weekly run followed by coffee and conversation.
clubs.active_evidence: Weekly Meetup event, next on 3 Oct 2026, recurring to Jan 2027

clubs.name: runnr club (BGC)
clubs.description: The community club of the runnr running-specialty store chain, which holds weekly group runs with partner clubs in BGC, Cebu and Cagayan de Oro. The page lists its coaching team, which includes USATF-, RRCA- and UESCA-certified coaches.
clubs.active_evidence: Weekly-runs schedule on the club page, live Sep 2026 (same page carries Aug 2026 posts)

clubs.name: 5AM Gang Run Club
clubs.who: Open to all who show up
clubs.description: A large community club that Tatler Asia reported holds weekly runs in Alabang, BGC and UP Diliman, and that asks runners to leave headphones at home so they can talk. Its Wednesday BGC run is co-hosted with runnr club.
clubs.active_evidence: Listed as runnr club's Wednesday BGC run on runnr's live weekly-runs page, Sep 2026

clubs.name: RWP Run Club (Run with Pat)
clubs.who: All levels, from beginners to marathoners and trail runners
clubs.description: A large club with local chapters in Alabang, BGC, Makati, Pasig, Pasay and Quezon City, among others. Weekly schedules are posted in its Facebook group and on Instagram, and the club is part of the TBR Run Collective.
clubs.active_evidence: Its Cebu chapter is listed as runnr club's Tuesday run on runnr's live weekly-runs page, Sep 2026; no dated Manila schedule seen

clubs.name: Makati Metro Hash House Harriers (M3H3)

meets.when: 2nd and 4th Sundays of the month, 3:00pm start
meets.where: Varies by run; each run's meeting point, directions and transport are posted on the hareline

clubs.cost: Hash cash applies; check the current amount with the M3H3 organisers
clubs.description: A long-running hash kennel that holds trail runs in the usual Hash format. Run locations change, so check the hareline before each run for the meeting point and any shared transport.
clubs.active_evidence: Run #2167 posted for Sunday 4 Oct 2026; details corrected by the M3H3 organisers by email, 30 Sep 2026

clubs.name: Manila Hash House Harriers (MH3)
clubs.description: Manila's original hash kennel, whose first trail was laid in 1972. It holds a trail run every Monday evening, followed by drinks.

coaches.name: The Bull Runner / TBR Dream Marathon
coaches.offers: First-marathon training programmes (TBR Basecamp, Beginner marathon programmes, TBR Dream Plus) leading to the TBR Dream Marathon, plus strength, yoga and meditation coaching
coaches.credentials: Founder coach: USATF and RRCA running coach; lead coach: World Triathlon Level 2 coach
coaches.description: A Manila-based marathon programme built around a race for first-time marathoners, with a published coaching team. Past participants have formed the TBR Run Collective of clubs.
coaches.active_evidence: TBR InLife Dream Marathon 2026 held (Feb 2026); 2027 second-chance registration and policy updates posted Jun to Jul 2026

coaches.name: We Ken Run
coaches.offers: Paid group speed sessions, 6-month marathon training (₱37,500), focused training (₱22,500), remote marathon coaching (₱48,000), and a ₱1,000 trial session that counts toward a package
coaches.where: Weekly speed sessions at BGC, Alabang or UP Diliman, 4:45am to about 7am
coaches.credentials: Head coach: USA Track & Field Level 1
coaches.description: A coached running team of 100+ runners with groups for different paces, beginners included. Registration is online, and walk-ins are not accepted for speed sessions.
coaches.active_evidence: Site promotion for trial sessions in the week of 23 Feb (2026); site © 2026
